title: DSFlow: A Neuro-Symbolic Data Workflow Agent with Statistical Diagnostic Guardrails
title_zh: DSFlow：带有统计诊断护栏的神经符号数据工作流智能体
abstract_en: Data science workflows often require tools that presume non-trivial technical knowledge. Large language models (LLMs) reduce this barrier, but a gap remains between flexible general-purpose agents and statistically controlled pipelines. We introduce DSFlow, a LangGraph-based neuro-symbolic data-agent platform that combines reusable, LLM-selected skills with deterministic diagnostic guardrails. Skills provide extensible task knowledge. Symbolic validation can accept a proposed method, request clarification or replanning, override an unsuitable method, or supply a safe fallback. Regression and clustering case studies illustrate how DSFlow uses diagnostic evidence to correct method choices and documents those decisions in auditable reports.
abstract_zh: 数据科学工具往往要求用户具备一定的专业知识。大语言模型（LLM）降低了使用门槛，但通用智能体的灵活性与分析流程所需的统计约束之间仍有差距。DSFlow 是一个基于 LangGraph 的神经符号数据智能体平台，将 LLM 选择的可复用技能与确定性的统计诊断护栏相结合。技能封装可扩展的任务知识；符号校验则依据诊断结果接受候选方法、要求澄清或重新规划、替换不适用的方法，或提供稳妥的备选方案。回归与聚类案例展示了 DSFlow 如何依据诊断证据纠正方法选择，并在可审计报告中记录决策依据。
key_points_zh: DSFlow 基于 LangGraph，将 LLM 的技能选择与确定性的统计诊断分开，兼顾灵活性与统计约束。
可复用技能封装任务知识；符号校验可接受候选方法、请求澄清或重新规划，也可替换不适用的方法或启用备选方案。
回归和聚类案例展示了如何用诊断证据修正方法选择，并通过可审计报告追溯决策依据。

llm_assessment.comment: Deterministic diagnostics give selected skills an auditable path to replanning or fallback, though regression and clustering case studies provide limited evidence of reuse.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 确定性诊断能触发可审计的重规划或降级处理，但回归和聚类案例对框架可复用性的证明仍然有限。
